context: Ren explains a funding plan to Yuki.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: finance discussion; capital vocabulary (資金/発行/株/銀行/利益) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 新しい事業に、資金が必要です。
lines.en: We need funds for the new venture.
lines.style: measured young analyst voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 資金は、どこから集めますか?
lines.en: Where do we raise the funds?
lines.style: attentive office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 株を発行して、資金を集めます。
lines.en: We'll issue shares to raise funds.
lines.style: precise young analyst voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 銀行からも、借りるんですか?
lines.en: Do we also borrow from the bank?
lines.style: thoughtful office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 銀行の融資と、株の発行を組み合わせます。
lines.en: We combine a bank loan with a share issue.
lines.style: measured young analyst voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 利益が出るまで、時間はかかりますか?
lines.en: Will it take time until we see profit?
lines.style: curious office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 二年ほどで、利益が見込めます。
lines.en: We can expect profit in about two years.
lines.style: confident young analyst voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 資金の計画、よく分かりました。
lines.en: I understand the funding plan well.
lines.style: satisfied office woman voice, soft warm clarity closing throughout
